milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the horses (spawned at ~10,0,5 and ~11,0,6) and face toward them, modeling 'player can see the horse'. Target is the center of the horse area at [10, 0, 5], max_distance=16 allows detection from moderate range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the horses.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the terracotta U-structure (centered around ~-6,1,-6) and face toward it. Target is the center of the structure at [-6, 1, -6], max_distance=16 allows detection from moderate range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind=mob) because the task requires the player to lead a horse to the terracotta area. We check that at least one horse entity is present within a generous box around the terracotta structure ([-12,-1,-12] to [0,4,0]). This confirms the horse was successfully manoeuvred from its spawn location (~10,0,5) to the terracotta area (~-6,1,-6). The box is generous (12x5x12) to account for imprecise positioning after leading.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted golden helmet ends up in the player's inventory. The player must collect 5 gold ingots from the chest at the terracotta structure and use the adjacent crafting table to craft the helmet. The helmet is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.
